questions.question: Briefly explain the scope of digital economics in modern economic context.
questions.solution_html:
• Briefly explain the scope of digital economics in modern economic context.
  • Digital economics studies how digital technologies like the internet, data, and platforms influence
  • production, distribution, and consumption. Its scope includes areas such as e-commerce, digital
  • payments, platform economy, fintech, and data-driven business models. It also examines issues like
  • network effects, digital competition, privacy, and regulation in the modern economy. Overall, digital
  • economics helps understand how technology is transforming markets, businesses, and economic
  • growth.
questions.final_answer: growth
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: What is ecommerce payment gateways?
questions.solution_html:
• An e-commerce payment gateway is a digital service that helps online businesses to accept payments
  • securely from customers. It acts as an intermediary between the customer, the merchant, and the bank
  • to process transactions. Payment gateways support methods like credit/debit cards, UPI, net banking
  • and digital wallets.
questions.final_answer: and digital wallets
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: Briefly mention the purpose of the DPDP Act, 2023.
questions.solution_html:
• Briefly mention the purpose of the DPDP Act, 2023.
  • (Value liberally)
  • The Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) Act, 2023 aims to regulate the collection, processing
  • and storage of personal data in India. It seeks to protect individuals’ privacy by giving them rights
  • over their personal data and ensuring responsible data handling by organizations. The Act also
  • establishes a legal framework for accountability, consent, and penalties in case of data misuse or
  • breaches.
questions.final_answer: breaches

questions.question: Critically examine productivity gains and labour market impacts of LLMs.
questions.solution_html:
• Critically examine productivity gains and labour market impacts of LLMs.
  • (Value Liberally)
  • LLMs improve productivity by automating routine cognitive tasks such as writing, coding, data
  • analysis, and customer support-reduce time and costs for firms, enabling faster decision-making and
  • scaling of operations. Critical examination: Still, these gains are uneven, benefiting high-skill
  • workers more and potentially widening inequality. In the labour market, LLMs may displace certain
  • white-collar and entry-level jobs while transforming many others. At the same time, they can create
  • new roles related to AI management, prompt engineering, and oversight. Overall, the impact is mixed
  • in nature, offering productivity gains but also posing challenges of job displacement, skill mismatch
  • and the need for reskilling. Still, LLMs may give more gains compared to losses.
questions.final_answer: and the need for reskilling. Still, LLMs may give more gains compared to losses
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: Discuss the role of major digital enterprise technologies in improving business / performance.
questions.solution_html:
• Major digital enterprise technologies such as cloud computing, big data analytics, and artificial
  • intelligence helps business performance by improving efficiency and better decision-making. Cloud
  • computing reduces infrastructure costs and provides scalable resources for businesses. Big data
  • analytics enables firms to extract insights from large datasets, helping in better strategic planning and
  • customer understanding. AI automates processes, improves accuracy, and supports predictive analysis.
  • Enterprise systems like ERP and CRM integrate business functions and improve coordination across
  • departments. Overall, these technologies increase productivity, competitiveness, and innovation in
  • modern businesses.
  • (The benefits may differ based on the technology concerned- so valuation should be flexible based
  • on the technology suggested by the student.)
questions.final_answer: on the technology suggested by the student.)
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: Discuss the cost advantages of digital enterprices while considering pricing / decisions.
questions.solution_html:
• Digital enterprises benefit from lower fixed costs by reducing the need for physical infrastructure and
  • manual operations. They also experience near-zero marginal costs for reproducing digital products
  • enabling economies of scale. This cost structure allows firms to adopt flexible pricing strategies such
  • as freemium, subscription, and dynamic pricing. Lower costs enable competitive pricing while
  • maintaining profitability. Digital enterprises can also use data analytics to optimize pricing based on
  • demand and user behavior. Overall, cost advantages enhance pricing efficiency and market
  • competitiveness.
